incident-bot: :rotating_light: HIGH: 5xx spike from gateway (10m): TLS handshake failures increasing from 0.2% -> 18%. Auto-escalating to #incidents and paging oncall.
Ana (oncall-sre): I’m on it. seeing a huge uptick in `tls_handshake_error` in the gateway logs. correlates with CA rotation window ~15m ago.
Jay (infra): ok looking at the rotator logs now — I see `kms decrypt failed` for the new CA bundle around 1891234200. possible partial rotation?
Lee (platform): Gateway (edge-proxy) is returning 502/504 with logs: `tls: handshake failure` and occasional `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority`. mTLS policies enabled for a subset of routes.
Maya (support): I’ve started a blast message to affected customers (IDs: C-112, C-98) with the standard "intermittent gateway errors" template. customers reporting timeouts in ingest.
Ana (oncall-sre): quick triage checklist: 1) confirm cert expiry/chain 2) verify trust anchor set on edge-proxy 3) check rotator/KMS 4) consider rollback to previous CA bundle.
Ana (oncall-sre): running quick openssl check against gateway from infra jumpbox:
```
openssl s_client -connect gateway.prod.redwood.ai:443 -showcerts
# result: "verify return code: 21 (unable to verify the first certificate)"
```
Jay (infra): grabbed the secret on the rotator pod: `kubectl -n infra get secret ca-rotation -o yaml` shows two bundles: `current` (new) and `previous`. The new bundle has a different root subject and some services still signed by previous CA. Looks like rotator marked rotation complete before all clients were reissued.
Lee (platform): config on edge-proxy: `trusted_ca_bundle: /etc/ssl/certs/ca-bundle.pem` — it was reloaded at 1891234187. rotator pushed new bundle but some downstream gw instances are still on old bundle (rolling restart in progress). We have a window where client certs and gateway trust anchors disagree.
Ana (oncall-sre): mitigation options: A) force rollback to previous CA bundle on gateway (fast) B) continue rotation and expedite client cert reissue (slow) C) enable gateway fallback to accept both bundles temporarily.
Jay (infra): I can push previous bundle back (rollback) to all edge-proxy nodes. Will take ~6m to roll. prepping command: `kubectl -n edge set data configmap/edge-ca --from-file=ca-bundle.pem=previous_ca.pem` then `kubectl rollout restart daemonset/edge-proxy`.
Lee (platform): recommend rollback to restore service ASAP and then plan a controlled re-rollout with staged client reissue. agree with rollback.
Maya (support): ETA to customers if rollback goes through? I’ll update the page.
Ana (oncall-sre): Do it. Jay please do the rollback and post progress. I’ll coordinate post-rollback verification and traffic checks.
Jay (infra): starting rollback now. kicking `kubectl apply` and restart.
deploy-bot: Deploy started by Jay (infra) — rollout status: 0/12 updated.
Jay (infra): 6/12 updated, 9/12, 12/12. All edge-proxy pods restarted with previous bundle.
deploy-bot: Rollout complete for daemonset/edge-proxy (12 pods updated).
Ana (oncall-sre): running quick smoke against previously affected endpoints:
```
curl -v https://gateway.prod.redwood.ai/health
# now returns 200 OK; TLS handshake successful
```
Ana (oncall-sre): metric check: 5xx rate dropped from 18% -> 0.9% over the last 5m. Latency and error budgets look normalizing.
Tom (cust-success): I pushed an update to the customers: "We’ve identified a certificate rotation inconsistency and performed a rollback; services should be recovering. We'll follow up with a postmortem and timeline"
Maya (support): customers are reporting fewer errors. keeping the incident page open to catch late regressions.
Lee (platform): action items post-incident: 1) add pre-rotation validation to ensure all clients have reissued certs or gateway accepts dual bundles 2) make rotator atomic (don’t mark complete until all nodes confirm) 3) add a canary gating on a subset of edges.
Ana (oncall-sre): agree. Also add an automated smoke test post-rotation that checks mTLS handshake across sample clients.
Jay (infra): filing infra ticket to add a fallback config and to update rotator to wait for quorum. I’ll include KMS decrypt retry improvements. ticket: INFRA-2389.
Ana (oncall-sre): handing off to Jay for next 30m monitoring and to implement fixes. I’m logging incident and will schedule an on-call postmortem tomorrow 10:00 UTC.
incident-bot: Incident severity lowered to SEV-2. Pager cleared.
Ana (oncall-sre): timeline summary (for postmortem): 1) 1891234200 — rotator pushed new CA bundle and marked complete 2) 1891234260 — first customer errors observed 3) 1891234567 — paging triggered 4) 1891234700 — rollback started 5) 1891234860 — rollback complete, recovery observed.
Tom (cust-success): will coordinate customer follow-ups and include the planned remediation windows.
Maya (support): leaving monitoring for another hour; will escalate if we see new spikes.
Ana (oncall-sre): thanks team. closing thread once infra ticket and postmortem are created. :white_check_mark:
